verdict.rationale: Trivy's official MCP server (trivy-mcp) enables 'natural language scanning' — asking questions about security issues in natural language via MCP-enabled tools like VS Code — which is the closest evidence to AI-generated insights inside the product. However, this is a separate plugin, not native AI-generated suggestions built into core Trivy, and there's no evidence of Trivy itself producing AI-driven remediation suggestions or insights beyond raw scan results. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of AI-generated remediation/insight generation within core Trivy output, independent hands-on validation of the MCP natural-language feature's quality, and detail on what 'insights' beyond raw vulnerability listing it actually produces.
